verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents natural-language operation in several ways. HyperAgent's `page.ai("search for flights... select the cheapest option")` lets users write natural-language commands instead of selectors, and `page.extract()` and the Extract API take natural-language prompts. Its cloud browser agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, BrowserUse) start tasks with a single API call, and an official MCP server exposes its capabilities to AI models. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work reliably, a direct conversational interface (natural language is always wrapped in SDK/API code), and an explicit example of a natural-language task prompt for the hosted agents API.
